_meta.origin: Refinement of user's JSON #4 (Bullish Momentum Launchpad)
fixes_applied_vs_v1: clarified trigger vs confirmation (2 consecutive closes above OR high)
inverted pyramid sizing (largest first) to avoid top-heavy exposure on reversals
replaced 15m-low trail with hybrid max(15m_low, EMA9-0.5*ATR)
added failed-breakout fast exit within 2 candles
aligned EOD force-flat to 14:30 consistent with existing bot
added DTE gate (>=2) and spread conversion on 0-1 DTE
converted deployment-% sizing to risk-% sizing

pre_conditions.gap_fill_guard: price at 09:30 must still be > prev_day_close (gap not filled)
pre_conditions.prev_day_confluence_preferred: OR_high > prev_day_high  (bonus, not mandatory — gates down pyramid step if absent)
pre_conditions.dte_spread_switch: convert to 1-wide debit spread if DTE <= 3

entry_logic.trigger: first 5m candle after 09:30 that closes above OR_high
entry_logic.confirmation: next 5m candle also closes above OR_high

pyramiding.lot_1_trigger: entry confirmation (2nd candle close above OR_high)
pyramiding.lot_2_trigger: price >= entry + 0.25*ATR AND lot_1 in profit
pyramiding.lot_3_trigger: price >= entry + 0.50*ATR AND lot_2 in profit
pyramiding.on_each_add: move SL on all prior lots to breakeven of latest add

trailing_stop.comment: Gives noise room but catches real reversals faster than a pure 15m low

failed_breakout_fast_exit.condition: price closes back below OR_high within 2 candles of lot_1 entry
failed_breakout_fast_exit.reason: failed breakouts are the most expensive trades; exit fast

trend_reversal.condition: trailing stop hit (prev 15m low or EMA9-based stop)

regime_flip.condition: classifier regime flips away from TREND_UP_GAP

daily_halts.comment: Only 1 Launchpad trade per day — once exited, do not re-enter on same OR
